function.name: add_todo
function.description: Adds a new todo item to the todo.csv file with auto-generated ID, timestamp, and pending status.

todo_text.description: The text content of the todo item to be added.

path.description: The file path to the todo.csv file. If not provided, the default path will be used.

function.name: delete_todo
function.description: Deletes a todo item from the todo.csv file by its ID. Returns True if deletion was successful, False otherwise.

todo_id.description: The ID of the todo item to delete.

path.description: Optional file path to the todo.csv file.
